status: preregistered synthetic crop-model-v2 root-depth and production-response software fixture; candidate not run

source.citation: Allen et al. (1998), Crop Evapotranspiration: Guidelines for Computing Crop Water Requirements, FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56, Chapter 8, Table 22 and footnotes 1–2.
source.sourceVersion: FAO-56 (1998), Chapter 8, Table 22; official HTML chapter page.
source.licenseOrReuse: FAO publication; derived numerical references and method equations only, with no source text or code copied.

referenceValues.rootDepthFootnote: The larger value is applicable where soil layering or other restrictions do not limit rooting; the source associates larger values with modeling soil-water stress and rainfed conditions.

classification: Synthetic software invariant only. The FAO-56 maximum-depth range endpoints are used as fixed scenario bounds; this is not a tomato root-growth trajectory, soil profile, crop calibration, measured comparison, or prediction.

crop.cultivar: not asserted; frozen catalog identity routes the software fixture only

thermalParameters.maturityEndpoint: First ripe harvest (four or more fruits show ripe color)
thermalParameters.accumulationMethod: Single sine with horizontal cutoff; OSU Table 6
thermalParameters.sourceCitation: Andrews et al., OSU Extension EM 9305, Tomato degree-days, Table 6 (four cultivars; 1844–2010 °F·days).
thermalParameters.useLimit: Frozen only to keep the crop active and below maturity for ten synthetic ticks; cultivar and maturity accuracy are not asserted.

soil.classification: Both numeric soil inputs are synthetic software values; not an observed profile or fertility estimate.

rootZone.depthInterpretation: The two values are the endpoints of the source maximum-depth range and are synthetic fixed-depth boundary scenarios. No rootDevelopment profile or crop trajectory is implied.

production.classification: All production values are synthetic and are frozen only to expose the v2 root-zone water-stress multiplier.

dailyEnvironment.provenance: Every daily value is synthetic software forcing, not source weather or a measured site series.

syntheticInputs.pairedRuns: Both frozen crop-model-v2 runs have identical crop, frozen crop record, soil, production, ten-day environment series, planting event and management settings. The only changed parameter is rootZone.effectiveRootDepthCm: 70 cm versus 150 cm. Both initial storage fractions are 1, so each starts at its own TAW.

expected.recurrence: p=clamp(0.40+0.04*(5-6),0.1,0.8)=0.36; TAW=AWC*root depth; RAW=p*TAW; Ks=1 when beginning depletion<=RAW, otherwise clamp((TAW-depletion)/(TAW-RAW),0,1); actual transpiration=min(storage,6*Ks); next storage=storage-actual transpiration; synthetic daily DM gain=4*Ks g/m². Keep values unrounded.
expected.pairedOutcome: The shallow scenario first has Ks<1 on day 8; the deep scenario remains at Ks=1 for all 10 days. Both storage traces remain nonnegative. The shallow day-10 cumulative synthetic DM is 38.27543048469388 g/m² versus 40 g/m² deep. Both runs remain alive, active, immature, and unharvested; heat, cold and nitrogen stress are zero.
expected.massBalance: For each day: beginning storage + precipitation + irrigation + capillary rise + root-growth storage - runoff - deep drainage - actual transpiration - ending storage = 0 mm.

acceptanceChecks.dispatchAndFreeze: Both records use crop-model-v2/run-inputs-v2/crop-parameters-v3; frozen parameter snapshots contain the exact synthetic soil, production, root-zone and crop values. Ordinary new-run default remains v1.
acceptanceChecks.pairedInputs: The two RunConfigs and frozen crop snapshots are identical except effectiveRootDepthCm; both initial storage fractions are exactly 1 and rootDevelopment is absent.
acceptanceChecks.dailyTrace: Assert every registered daily row for stress coefficient, actual transpiration, end storage, end depletion, dry-matter increment and cumulative dry matter.
acceptanceChecks.waterBalance: Assert per-tick water mass balance, max residual, nonnegative storage, zero inflow/runoff/root-growth/deep drainage, and no uptake above potential ETc or available storage.
acceptanceChecks.productionConsequence: Assert the shallow run begins water stress on day 8, the deep run remains unstressed through day 10, and the expected day-10 cumulative DM ordering/values hold.
acceptanceChecks.nonWaterTerms: Assert zero heat, cold and nitrogen stress, no maturity or harvest events, and no death in all 20 ticks.
acceptanceChecks.deterministicReplay: Repeat both ten-day traces from the same frozen inputs/environment series; events, cells, residuals and summaries must match exactly.

toleranceReview.status: approved before candidate execution by independent GPT-6 Luna max validator S2; candidate execution not authorized
toleranceReview.reviewedBy: S2, independent GPT-6 Luna max validator
toleranceReview.reviewSummary: S2 independently verified FAO-56 Table 22 tomato values and footnotes, recomputed all 20 daily recurrence rows (maximum absolute difference 7.11e-15), and approved the arithmetic-only tolerances and synthetic scope. No candidate test was run.
toleranceReview.rationale: Arithmetic-only bounds for the frozen double-precision FAO-56 and v2 RUE recurrence over at most ten daily updates. Exact source-reference transcription, model dispatch, frozen inputs, stress onset day, direction, storage bounds, harvest/death state and replay equality are not tolerance-based. These values are not crop-error, calibration, holdout, measured-data or predictive tolerances.
